_comment: SOURCE tier manifest for the update feed. scripts/gen-updates-json.mjs stamps `latest` from package.json + `minReaderVersion` from src/renderer/src/lib/boardSchemaVersion.ts and publishes this to <feed>/updates.json. Main fetches it each check (src/main/autoUpdate.ts › getMeta) to pick the tier. `minSupportedByFloor` = canvas compat floor (MIN_READER_VERSION) → the minSupported that floor demands: the PR that raises the floor MUST add `"<floor>": "<its package.json version>"` and raise `minSupported` to match, or scripts/release-floor.test.ts + the release fail (project-workspaces O-2). Floors up to 23 predate that rule and demanded nothing beyond the old 0.9.0. See docs/contributing/releasing.md › Update levels.
